profile.headline: Full Stack Software Developer Solving Problems & Creating Opportunity w/ Desktop, Web, Mobile Apps & Database Solutions
profile.summary:
Elliotte Martin is a Software Development and Architecture Leader, who unites solid and broad, object-oriented engineering experience from high-level business requirements definition through design, production, release, and maintenance. Pragmatic with the ability to communicate clearly and suggest improvements, expertise developing commercial software, successfully designed and released products for DOS, Windows, the web, and mobile devices.

     📌 Changed MAX Database from Pervasive Btreive to SQL Server w/ 15 Developers in 1 Year
     📌 Moved MAX Product from 1M+ Lines of DOS Code to Windows without Issues
     📌 Managed 6 Software Developers to Exceed Organizational Goals & KPIs
     📌 Created 75+ Successful Windows Desktop, Web & Mobile Applications 

Elliotte Martin is proficient in working with the full stack of software that spans user interface, backend, server-side development, databases and Windows, and mobile client devices. His specialties include Object Oriented Design and Programming, Visual C++ 6.0, C#, VB .NET, ASP .NET, ASP .NET MVC, Xamarin, XML, JSON, Javascript, WebAPI, ATL, COM, MFC, SQL Server, SQLite, and Pervasive. 

If you are open to sharing best practices or brainstorming on:
     📌 Developing Competitive Advantages through Desktop, Web & Mobile Solutions
     📌 Designing Effective, Pragmatic Solutions that Exceed Customer Expectations
     📌 Sharing & Discovering Cutting Edge Technologies and Processess

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead software engineer for Dolphin Imaging 2D graphics. Maintained and enhanced existing MFC, C++ and WPF application. Created COM components for TWAIN integration and image embedding in other applications. Ported Imaging Viewer application from WPF to MAUI for multi-platform support.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · WPF · MAUI · SQL Server · C++ MFC

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
As a Software Architect for ECi Software Solutions (formerly Exact Software), Eliotte Martin propels his team to design and architect new web-based platform to move existing Windows-based Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) package (MAX) to the web for this global software company serving SMB manufacturing and distribution clients located across the US, Canada, and Europe. Devised prototypes and collaborated to oversee overseas development and complete parts of the software not performed by the offshore technical team in support of organizational transition. Maintain existing C++ programs and develop custom programs for customers.
•	Engineered new version of product using Javascript front-end (ExtJS) and ASP.NET MVC backend with ADO.NET and SQL Server as the database layer writing Javascript, C#, and T-SQL code (stored procedures, User Defined Functions (UDF) and triggers) and new Software Development Kit (SDK) in C# adding a REST interface
•	Developed mobile product using Sencha Touch and ASP.NET WebAPI to provide web services performing backend business objects by porting the business layer logic from C++ and ADO to C#, ADO.NET, and stored procedures 
•	Wrote Estimating module using Silverlight and Entity Framework
•	Re-skinned C++ and .NET modules using Codejock components to enhance software with a more modern look
•	Transformed several custom programs for customers, for example, to send data from a company to its parent SAP system

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
As a Mobile Application Developer for Norcal Software, Elliotte Martin designed, developed, and published mobile applications to Apple App, Google Play, Amazon Kindle, Windows Phone, and Windows App stores which work on Apple, Android, Windows 8/10 (WinRT), and Windows phones.
•	Developed TimePlusTime app using Xamarin Forms, C#, and XAML, published in Apple App, Google Play, Kindle, and Windows App stores, won 1st place in Mobile App category at the 2015 San Mateo county fair
•	Created ColorFinder app using Xamarin, C#, and XAML, published in Google Play, Kindle, and Windows Phone App stores, won the 2nd place in Mobile App at 2015 San Mateo county fair 
•	Engineered ColorFinder for WinRT on Windows 8/10 using C#, and XAML, published to Windows App store

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
As a Consultant for Baxter Research, Elliotte Martin designed and developed XML and SOAP interfaces using ASP .NET web Services and VB .NET for this background search company. Created and wrote a Windows Form application using C# and SQL Lite (initially SQL Server).
•	Rewrote ASP classic websites to use ASP .NET web forms and 2-Factor authentication for heightened security as one of the sites is used to order background searches
•	Used VB .NET, ASP .NET, XML and SOAP to design web services to exchange order information (orders for background checks) and results to and from field researchers and customers
•	Developed C# Windows Forms application for remote researchers to download work orders and upload results for criminal record searches, upgrading to use SQLite
•	Used VBA, Wininet, AJAX, and SOAP to implement automated interfaces in Access

positions.title: Development Manager
positions.description:
As a Development Manager for Exact Software, Elliotte Martin directed a team comprised of 4 US developers and 2 Dutch developers to for this global ERP software company with 2000 customers dispersed across the US, Europe, South America, and Mexico before acquisition by ECI. Led as a working manager while maintaining 60% development responsibility
•	Spearheaded the rewriting of C++, VB 6, and Crystal Reports codebase to use a new database, 80%+ customer base migrated to new product
•	Ported Advanced Shipping module from VB 6 to VB .NET 
•	Integrated with the parent company’s CRM package (e-Synergy) using XML and AJAX

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
As a Software Architect for Exact Software, Elliotte Martin boosted all aspects of a 32 bit Windows client-server ERP product, including design, development, debugging, and maintenance. Used UI programming, business rules programming, and database programming using ADO and SQL Server. Wrote the core product in C++ and MFC with some ATL and VB components; used Crystal Reports for reporting and Great Plains accounting for financials.
•	Architected SQL Server version (it previously used Pervasive Btrieve for the database)
•	Pioneered several new modules and enhancements using C++ and MFC and maintained existing modules
•	Created a COM wrapper around business rules DLLs, so a custom ASP or ASP .NET front end could be used with XML to create Sales orders, Purchase orders and to perform inventory transactions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Senior Software Engineer for Embarcadero Technologies, Elliotte Martin focused primarly on the Embarcadero's RapidSQL product.  Worked on both UI and business rules programming for the product. Used the following technologies: Visual C++, MFC, ATL and COM.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: As a contracted Software Developer for Micro Mrp Inc., Elliotte Martin coded on the DOS version using BASIC and then the Windows Visual C++ version of the MAX ERP product.  By the end of his tenure Elliotte was the Lead Developer.
